reward.title: A Cute Birthday Wish
reward.message: I wish that every time you look in the mirror today, you see exactly what I see — the most beautiful, wonderful, incredible person in the entire world.

reward.title: A Big Virtual Hug
reward.message: Arms wide open, wrapping you in the warmest, tightest, most love-filled hug imaginable. Hold on a little longer... there you go. Happy Birthday.

reward.title: A Secret Memory
reward.message: Do you remember the first time you made me genuinely laugh? I thought to myself — I never want this to end. I still feel that way every day.

reward.title: A Romantic Note
reward.message: In every life I live, in every story I get to tell — I hope I always find my way back to you. You are the best thing that ever happened to me.

reward.title: A Birthday Blessing
reward.message: May this year open every door you've been waiting for. May you be surrounded by love, lit up by joy, and proud of the incredible woman you are becoming.

reward.title: A Little Surprise
reward.message: You are loved more than any words can hold. More than any song can carry. More than any gift can show. Just... more. Always more.
